nextComparison: Use upstreamCommit as the old ref and the local official checkout HEAD as the new ref. Do not fetch latest automatically or scan the complete card catalog.
First diff edition files and the recorded script paths. Read only newly changed editions dated >= firstSetDate, including updates to existing sets and later sets.
Match exact face names and collector numbers; do not infer coverage from the largest collector number. Distinguish A- rebalanced cards and alternate faces.

Skip scripts whose officialGitBlob is unchanged. Compare changed blobs to diySha256Lf; protect local edits and retain intentionally different existing revisions unless the requested scope includes them.
Recheck notImplementedUpstream when the official snapshot adds a matching script. Add only required token/type/engine dependencies.
After verification and deployment, replace this checkpoint with the new upstream ref and exact entry/hash coverage.
validationLimits: All imported scripts instantiate in the installed DIY engine with the targeted patch. Four targeted behavior tests pass. This is not a full match simulation of every card.
